headline: Marine microplastics can keep carrying hazardous additives
summary: A new study finds plastic fragments can remain mobile sources of chemicals such as HBCD after breaking apart.
script: Marine microplastics can keep carrying hazardous additives even after they break apart. Researchers say fragments may act as mobile sources of persistent chemicals, meaning smaller pieces do not automatically mean lower risk.
imageAlt: Microplastic fragments collected from a waterway, photographed by NOAA’s Marine Debris Program.
imageAltTwo: Microplastic fragments mixed with sand in a NOAA marine-debris image.

sources.title: Marine microplastics carry chemicals from plastic additives after fragmentation
